title: What welders do
d: Welders join metal with heat: structural steel, pipelines, pressure vessels, automotive, and artistic fabrication. The main processes are MIG, TIG, stick, and f
description: Welders join metal with heat: structural steel, pipelines, pressure vessels, automotive, and artistic fabrication. The main processes are MIG, TIG, stick, and flux-core — each with its sweet spot. Certified welders in pipelines and pressure vessels earn top trade wages.

title: Essential tools
d: Welding machine, auto-darkening helmet, MIG gun or TIG torch, stick electrode holder, angle grinder with cutting and grinding discs, chipping hammer, wire brush
description: Welding machine, auto-darkening helmet, MIG gun or TIG torch, stick electrode holder, angle grinder with cutting and grinding discs, chipping hammer, wire brush, clamps, magnets, soapstone markers, and proper PPE.

title: Key skills
d: Steady travel speed, correct arc length, reading weld symbols on blueprints, joint preparation (beveling, cleaning), and knowing which process and settings fit
description: Steady travel speed, correct arc length, reading weld symbols on blueprints, joint preparation (beveling, cleaning), and knowing which process and settings fit each metal and position. Overhead and vertical positions separate pros from beginners.

title: Safety essentials
d: Arc flash burns eyes in seconds — helmet always down. Ventilate: welding fumes are toxic, especially galvanized steel (metal fume fever). Fire watch: sparks tra
description: Arc flash burns eyes in seconds — helmet always down. Ventilate: welding fumes are toxic, especially galvanized steel (metal fume fever). Fire watch: sparks travel; keep extinguishers close. Leather, not synthetics — synthetics melt to skin.

title: Getting started
d: Trade school or community college welding programs teach the basics in months. Practice every position, then test for AWS certifications (3G/4G plate, 6G pipe).
description: Trade school or community college welding programs teach the basics in months. Practice every position, then test for AWS certifications (3G/4G plate, 6G pipe). Pipeline and underwater welding are the elite paths.

title: Pro tips
d: Clean metal welds better than any settings trick — grind to bright metal. Tack everything before full welds. Watch the puddle, not the arc. Keep a weld log of s
description: Clean metal welds better than any settings trick — grind to bright metal. Tack everything before full welds. Watch the puddle, not the arc. Keep a weld log of settings that worked. Grind your restarts.
